splits.test_cross_skill: a future explicitly held-out skill family; no cross-skill claim is allowed when every selected task is in training
splits.test_unseen_reset: seen tasks with held-out reset identities
splits.test_unseen_task_language: seen task semantics with later separately frozen language-template groups; not an unseen-task claim
splits.test_visual_shift: optional, only after a separately specified camera/appearance shift
splits.train: seen tasks and reset groups; no test identities
splits.validation: seen task families, held-out episode/reset groups
